note: ASSUMED starting numbers, not measurements. Change them and rerun fetch_migration.py; nothing else needs to move. How they are used: docs/MODEL.md, section 'Migration tracker'.
ducks_total_source: USFWS 2026 Waterfowl Population Status, Traditional Survey Area, May breeding index (as shown on the Ducks Unlimited graphic you supplied). It excludes this year's young and the Eastern Survey Area.
fall_flight_note: 1.0 uses the May index as the migrating pool. The real fall flight is larger because it adds this year's young; raise this once there is a source.
duck_weight_note: Radar sees every bird. Early in the window much of the night traffic is songbirds, so each night counts for less then. Linear between these knots (MM-DD, weight), 1.0 after the last. A placeholder to calibrate against Arkansas aerial surveys and your hunt log.
boundaries_note: A boundary is a line of latitude. The sites listed sit near it and say how fast birds cross it. north_at_start: share of the migratory pool north of the line on season_start. north_at_end: share still north of it after season_end (birds that winter there).
